artworks.title: C'était un beau cavalier...
artworks.description: The image depicts two women. One woman is seated on a bench, holding a book. She has her hair styled in a bun and wears a long-sleeved dress with patterns and a brooch. The other woman stands next to her, wearing a dress with puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice. Both women have intricate hairstyles and are surrounded by framed artworks on the wall.

artworks.title: Réception de Choiseul-Gouffier chez Hassan-Tchousch-Oglou
artworks.description: This image shows an indoor gathering in a richly decorated room. Many individuals are present engaging in various activities. The room features a detailed ceiling, arched windows, columns, carpets, and decorative items. The participants are dressed formally and some are on an elevated platform. Objects like shoes near the seating area suggest cultural practices. The meticulous rendering of textures and patterns enhances the depiction of the social interaction in a historical setting.

artworks.title: A  Street in Chartres
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache with scraping over touches of graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, with cathedral spires reaching towards the sky. The buildings have rustic architecture, including a cafe. The sky is light blue with clouds. People are depicted with impressionistic brushstrokes, adding movement and scale. Watercolor is used to create texture and light and shadow effects.

artworks.title: Figure on a Cloud
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in memory of David Stone
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a crouching person with most of their body visible, except for their head. The person is bent over with one arm out to the side and one leg bent backward. No facial features or hair are shown. The person is wearing loose clothing. There are no objects or jewelry in the illustration. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Artillerie du Diable (The Devil's Artillery)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a creature with a human head and wings. The image shows a large creature with exaggerated features, including a nose adorned with scissors, acting as a figure in combat. Soldiers or figures in military attire seem to be engaging in battle, with the creature expelling smaller figures and objects resembling cannonballs or debris. The scene is chaotic, with flags and labels indicating targets or ideologies. The overall tone is humorous and absurd.

artworks.title: Gare les Quilles
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring oversized and miniature figures. The scene includes a large woman in a gown holding a ball, small figures in uniform walking in formation, and a large seated man in formal attire holding a cane. The figures have exaggerated features and the background is minimal. The text "GARE LES QUILLES" adds humor or caution to the scene.

artworks.title: Cleric
artworks.description: The image features a man standing from the thighs up, with a slight leaning position and his left hand resting on his hip. His facial features are round, with a content expression, and he has a receding hairline with curly hair at the sides. He is wearing a dark, long robe with a high collar and a white clerical band around his neck. In his right hand, he holds a small book. The background showcases a village scene with buildings with steep roofs and a church steeple, drawn with sketch-like lines, suggesting a rural or small-town setting. The sky above is partly cloudy.

artworks.title: Domestic Dispute
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing facing a seated man. The woman is wearing a head scarf, shawl, long dress with lace at the hem, and shoes. She has her arms crossed and looks stern. The man is seated at a table, leaning against it with his arm resting on the surface. He has unkempt hair, a mustache, and is wearing a jacket, pants, and shoes. On the table are a large round container with a lid and bottles. The wall behind them has some sketches and a pinned picture. The setting appears to be inside, possibly a room with modest furnishings, like a detailed curtain and floor tiles.

artworks.title: Queue du premier Theâtre français
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theater entrance scene, depicting a crowded and lively atmosphere. The composition features a queue in front of the theater, with ornate columns and diverse individuals in various clothing styles. In the foreground, a shoe shiner is working, and a small dog is running across the street. The detailed drawing captures the energy and movement of the crowd, set against a grand architectural backdrop.

artworks.title: Les Frères Conduisent les Enfants, à St. Nicolas des Champs
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of boys and two adult men in historical attire. The boys are walking in a line from right to left, with one of the men guiding them and another standing to the side. A woman holding the reins of a donkey is also present on the left. In the background is an ornate building with tall arches and a cobblestone path.

artworks.title: Ah Ben!...
artworks.description: There are two individuals interacting. The person on the left is in a three-quarter view, bending slightly at the waist and gesturing with their right hand. They wear a loose-fitting coat, trousers, and a cap. The person on the right is visible from the knees up, leaning against a wall with their right hand near their chest. They have a round face with an animated expression and wear a hat, a dark jacket, a shirt, and light pants. The background shows sketch-like architectural elements and French text on the wall behind them.

artworks.title: Eight Vignettes of Genre Incidents
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes depicting everyday life and historical figures. There are multiple vignette-style illustrations showing different scenes including a young boy wearing a hat, people of various ages on a street, an elderly person on crutches, two women interacting at a doorway, an individual in Scottish attire with a sword, a person with two children walking, and an individual presenting something to a child. The drawing is detailed with a focus on varied characters and interactions.

artworks.title: Vue de Ruines et de fragments de Construction antique...de l'ancienne Capoue
artworks.artist: Emmanuel Jean Nepomucène de Ghendt after Claude-Louis Châtelet
artworks.description: The image features an illustration of ancient ruins seen from the front. In the center, a large arched structure appears weathered and aged. The horizon is low, showing distant vegetation and architectural elements. The illustration style is precise with detailed etching-like strokes capturing textures and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of sepia and gray. Close-up, scattered stones and ruins can be seen leading to a space where people and animals are depicted engaging in various activities. Light and shadow are used to enhance the depth and age of the scene.

artworks.title: Vue des Ruines d'un des Escaliers de l'Amphithéatre de Capue
artworks.description: The image displays ancient ruins with intricate architecture featuring large arches and pillars. In the distance, vegetation grows around the ruins. The horizon is not visible due to the structures. The artwork is detailed with fine etching, using cross-hatching for texture and shading. The color scheme is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow contrast. Three figures near the ruins, possibly scholars or gentlemen, provide scale to the scene.

artworks.title: Portici tirati dintorno ad un Foro con palazzo regio
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with classical structures viewed straight-on. The horizon is low, with elaborate building facades and Corinthian columns reaching upwards. Beyond, there are archways and buildings with intricate details. The image is created with precise line work, resembling an etching, and has a monochromatic color palette in shades of sepia or brown. Statues and ornamental elements adorn the structures, adding to the grandiose feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Appartenenze d'antiche terme con scale che conducono alla palestar, e al teatro
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene. The artwork features a grand and complex architectural setting filled with towering arches and classical columns. The architecture includes elements such as stone doorways, facade details, and vaulted ceilings. In the foreground, there are various classical buildings arranged in layers. The scene conveys a sense of majesty and combines elements of reality and imagination in its design.

artworks.title: Job Tormented by Demons and Abused by His Wife
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a print of a scene featuring a man surrounded by three demonic creatures. The creatures appear to be lifting him upwards, and his head is thrown back, his arms raised to either side. The demons have pointed ears, horns, sharp teeth, and bat-like wings. One holds a snake while another appears to hold a fiery whip. The central man is nude except for a cloth that is wrapped around his waist, and he is surrounded by rubble, including broken beams and shattered stones. On the right, a woman stands beside the man, looking towards him. She has wrinkled skin and a cloth covering her head. Below the print are two lines of text.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figure
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body, with their head slightly tilted downward and a serene expression. The hair is styled with hints of a headdress, and the clothing drapes loosely. The person appears to be cradling or resting against a rounded object. The sketch features soft lines and shading to outline the figure, set against an unadorned background with a central oval shape framing the figure.

artworks.title: Alphonse Karr
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an etching of a bust-length portrait showing a man from just below his shoulders upwards. The man is turned at a three-quarter angle, facing to the viewer's left. He has a beard that is full yet neatly groomed, with mustaches that blend into the beard. His hair is closely cropped and receding slightly on top. The man's nose is prominent. He has a thoughtful expression, with eyes appearing to look toward the horizon. He is clothed in what appears to be a formal garment, possibly a coat with a high collar, with visible buttons along the front. The etching is rendered using finely sketched lines that give texture to the clothing and facial features. The background is plain, with no distinct features, focusing all attention on the depicted figure. There are no visible objects or jewelry worn by the man.

artworks.title: Three Sleeping Sprites with a Satyr
artworks.description: The image depicts mythical creatures in a natural setting. A creature with horns rests on a grassy knoll beneath a tree, observing a group in the nearby water. In a grotto or cave-like area, three figures appear, partially submerged in water. The scene is densely etched, capturing textures of trees, grass, and flowing water. The creatures, with humanoid features, add a mythical ambiance to the scene. The drawing utilizes light and shadow to create depth and mood.

artworks.title: Girl Carrying a Basket of Fruit
artworks.description: The image features four nude individuals in a natural outdoor setting. The person on the left is standing upright on a raised surface, holding an object resembling a container or pot and leaning slightly toward the seated group. The seated figure in the center, with long wavy hair, looks toward the standing figure. Another individual, likely with their hair pulled back, is assisting the seated person. The last individual, sitting on a flat surface, has long hair cascading down their back and interacts with the center seated person. Dense foliage surrounds the scene, suggesting a forest with tall trees overhead and a body of water visible to the right.

artworks.title: Eros with Three Girls at a Fountain
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length female figures standing close together. One rests her hand on the other's shoulder. Both women have delicate facial features and soft curls in their hair. They are clothed in flowing fabrics covering the lower part of their bodies. They are near a classical stone fountain with intricate carvings. In the foreground, a small cherubic figure with wings plays music on a pipe. Lush greenery surrounds them, with dense trees and bushes extending into a forested background. Above the fountain, a small goat-legged figure, possibly a satyr, observes the scene. The setting evokes classical, mythological imagery.

artworks.title: Chasse Infernale
artworks.description: This image features various mythical creatures and figures in a chaotic, fantastical scene. The drawing shows demons, angels, horses, a chariot, and dynamic motions. The setting includes swirling action, flying figures, ethereal beings, and trees with twisted branches. The composition conveys movement and otherworldly elements, reminiscent of mythological adventures like the wild hunt.

artworks.title: Figurine Seller with Two Girls
artworks.description: The image shows three women from the waist up, standing closely together. The woman on the left stands in a profile view with her face turned towards the others, her hair styled up with gentle waves framing her face. She wears a sleeveless garment with a gathered waist. The woman in the middle is facing slightly towards the viewer, with curly hair cascading down her shoulders. Her facial features are soft with rounded cheeks, and her attire appears similar to that of the first woman. The woman on the right holds a basket filled with small sculptures and figures; her hair is shorter and styled in soft waves. She wears a dress with short sleeves and a gathered neckline. They are situated in an outdoor setting with a large urn adorned with sculpted figures and lush foliage visible behind them. In the background, there are relief sculptures of figures.
